name: cmux.chat.action/1
docs: Message actions in the agent chat: rows an extension adds to a message's actions menu ("Make an issue from this", "Send this reply to a doc"). The daemon lists the actions for a message of a role (apps.chat_actions.list {role}) from the manifest, so no script runs to draw the menu and a save of the manifest updates it. Picking a row sends apps-chat-action {app, action, message, gesture?}; the daemon runs the action's catalog op on the apps-run path with {action, message: {id, role, text, session?}}, holding it to the op's grants, install, enable and hidden checks.

id.description: The action's id within the app, sent back when it is picked.

symbol.description: An SF Symbol name for the row.

op.description: The app's catalog op that runs when the row is picked (its full or short name).

roles.description: The messages the row shows on; both when absent.

status: draft: shapes are refined with the first implementing app before the interface is public
